name: Sophia
source:
She has an eye for information and what she knows may make a few people raise an eyebrow. Directly asking Ryou information about Claire and Rina, Sophia wants an answer and means business. When she warns Ryou to make new friends, it bothers Ryou in many ways. Can Ryou trust her? Can he afford not to?
